description: This file implements a test mode adapter for MAC layer in a 5G NR protocol stack, including classes and methods to simulate and control test UEs, handle scheduling results, and modify MAC signaling for testing purposes.

classes.name: test_ue_mac_sdu_tx_builder_adapter
classes.description: Adapter class for MAC SDU transmission that auto-fills buffer state updates.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_cell_adapter
classes.description: Main class implementing test mode behavior for a MAC cell, including handling signaling, scheduling results, and UE creation.

classes.name: phy_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for PHY layer interactions, managing multiple cells and forwarding scheduler results.

classes.name: mac_test_mode_adapter
classes.description: Wrapper class for the MAC layer that adds test mode functionalities, including UE management and signaling modifications.

methods.name: handle_slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot timing indications, auto-generates CRC/UCI signals, and manages UE signaling in test mode.

methods.name: handle_error_indication
methods.description: Handles error events, including discarding pending data in case of errors.

methods.name: handle_stop_indication
methods.description: Handles stop signals for the cell.

methods.name: handle_crc
methods.description: Processes CRC indications, forcing success for test UEs if configured.

methods.name: forward_uci_ind_to_mac
methods.description: Forwards UCI indications to the real MAC layer.

methods.name: forward_crc_ind_to_mac
methods.description: Forwards CRC indications to the real MAC layer, with modifications for test UEs.

methods.name: handle_uci
methods.description: Processes UCI indications, modifying or removing UCI for test UEs.

methods.name: on_new_downlink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Intercepts and processes downlink scheduling results, updating test UEs accordingly.

methods.name: on_new_uplink_scheduler_results
methods.description: Intercepts and processes uplink scheduling results, updating internal history.

methods.name: on_cell_results_completion
methods.description: Handles completion of cell results, including creating test UEs after certain slots.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell in the test mode MAC, creating associated adapters and controllers.

methods.name: remove_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the test mode MAC.

methods.name: get_cell_controller
methods.description: Retrieves the controller for a specific cell.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Retrieves the subframe time mapper.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_state_update
methods.description: Updates DL buffer state for test UEs.

methods.name: adapt_bearers
methods.description: Modifies bearer configurations for test UEs, replacing SDU builders.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles UE creation requests, adding test-specific configurations.

methods.name: handle_ue_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for test UEs.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles deletion of UEs.

methods.name: handle_ul_ccch_msg
methods.description: Handles UL CCCH messages.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Handles application of UE configuration.
